name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 6 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2025-08-21, at wavelengths from 1.60 to 4.87 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
